guides.description: Add a button to the ENCY utilities menu or toolbar; runs on click with the full application context
Run code once when ENCY starts and once when it shuts down; no UI of its own
Intercept or wrap how another utility is executed - custom file selector, pre/post processing
Add items to the right-click menu of a technology operation in the operations tree
Add items to the right-click menu of a node in the 3D geometry model tree
Implement your own toolpath calculation algorithm for one or more operation types
Transform the calculated CLD toolpath data before it reaches the next pipeline stage
